steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Photography in fine art uses the camera as a creative tool, not just to document — consider composition, lighting, viewpoint intentionally. | Key Fact: Digital manipulation (Photoshop, apps) can transform images — but ethical considerations matter: how much manipulation is appropriate? | Key Fact: Moving image (film, animation, video art) adds time and narrative to visual art — consider sequence, pace, sound. | Key Fact: Combining traditional and digital processes creates unique hybrid works.
